text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. Satono 
Diamond seemed to be lost in thought about 
something.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
About two months until the Kikuka-sho... I 
wonder how much stronger I can become.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've yet developed the 
overwhelming power needed to brush off 
such jinxes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer camp focused mainly on 
fundamental training. The full-fledged 
tune-ups for the Kikuka Sho are really 
only just beginning.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. I know the fruits of my 
training won't show right away, but I 
can't help feeling impatient."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can't let something like this shake me! 
I won't lose to a jinx! I'll definitely 
overcome it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I've reset my mindset! I'm going to 
work even harder for the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her feelings about winning the Kikuka Sho 
must be so strong that they make her this 
impatient.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still—I feel she might be a bit too fired 
up. I just hope it doesn't end up 
backfiring on her...
